references.text: Jesus' friends come to Mary to comfort her, just as they came to Martha, showing that they share in the grief over her brother.
Jesus sees Mary weeping with the Jewish women who had come to comfort her and is deeply moved in spirit.
Mary comes to Jesus, falls at his feet, and says the same thing Martha had said earlier: if he had been there, her brother would not have died.
Many of the Jews who had come to Mary to comfort her believe in Jesus when they see what he did.
